milestones.name: Core on one server (Go; generations; Compose)

core-plan-apply.summary: M1 full CLI cycle verified on reset Ubuntu lab in 77.902 s: pinned apply/no-op/selective changes, rollback, health failure, contention, real CLI kill, GC and scoped destroy. OLY-30 closed the selective-recreation and revert gaps server-side; the lab was not re-run for it (no QEMU on the current host).

activator.summary: OLY-30: Recreate is a required Runner method with --no-build --pull never, a revert recreates the previous generation's restored tools, and a failed secret restoration takes the project down and reports exit 5. Offline tests green; lab not run (no QEMU on this host).

recipe-format.summary: OLY-55 adds a validated runtime block (shm_size, stop_grace_period, no_new_privileges, seccomp) rendering fixed Compose keys; the seccomp profile is a hashed store file. Offline tests green; lab not run (no QEMU). Real three-tool lab lifecycle passed earlier: native MCP references, skills, healthy containers, no-op/selective IDs, rollback and delete-data teardown.

first-recipes.summary: Real three-tool lab lifecycle passed: native MCP references, skills, healthy containers, no-op/selective IDs, rollback and delete-data teardown. Hermes pinned to v0.22.7.

shared-mcps-skills.summary: Real three-tool lab lifecycle passed: native MCP references, skills, healthy containers, no-op/selective IDs, rollback and delete-data teardown.

channels.summary: Hermes Telegram and Discord render as environment variables with a required allow-list; live bot test pending.

recipe-catalog.summary: OLY-56 adds recipes/openbot (ghcr.io/nightly-labs/openbot:0.62.0, vendored seccomp, runtime limits, /data volume, no port). OLY-19 adds recipes/claude-code (npm 2.1.318, /root/.mcp.json). OLY-20 adds recipes/gemini-cli (npm 0.67.0, settings.json MCP, mounted skills). OLY-57 adds transport: http|sse and claude-code/gemini-cli MCP styles for remote servers; golden tests updated; real goldens byte-identical. No lab run (no QEMU).

preflight.summary: Read-only preflight in plan/apply: OS, arch vs locked image platforms, RAM, disk and occupied ports (ignoring the current olympus generation). Offline tests only; lab not run (no QEMU on this host).
